Macron Orders Protection Against Russian Hybrid Attacks Amid Energy Crisis

French President Emmanuel Macron has ordered measures to protect critical infrastructure and defense industry sites against what he described as intensifying "Russian hybrid attacks." The announcement followed a meeting with French political party leaders to discuss the ongoing wars in the Middle East and Ukraine, and their impact on France's security and energy situation. Macron also stated that France would convene a G7 meeting focused on energy in the coming weeks, as soaring fuel prices coincide with international conflicts. The president's directive aims to bolster defenses against potential disruptions and interference.
